tools.name: about
tools.description: What DTA (dta.mn) is: Mongolia's signed, source-bound macro/market data archive — coverage, corpus size, how to verify.

tools.name: search_series
tools.description: Search the series catalog by code or name (English or Mongolian). Returns up to 15 series with codes to use in get_panel.

tools.name: get_panel
tools.description: Time series (latest vintage per date) for up to 8 series codes. Each point is [date, value, shortid]; the shortid is the signed-passport handle for get_datum.

tools.name: get_datum
tools.description: One signed observation's passport by shortid: value, vintage, source URL, schema, Ed25519 signature + the canonical payload recipe to verify it.

tools.name: get_movers
tools.description: Today's biggest movers across the archive — the signed movers:v0 snapshot (ranked by delta z-score).
